page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.3xlarge is a specialized instance designed primarily for high-capacity storage and data processing workloads. Driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, the server provides 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It includes 48 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio typical of general-purpose architectures. A key hardware differentiator is its massive integrated storage setup, offering 35,433 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Network connectivity is managed through a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Evaluation metrics demonstrate average performance across multi-threaded computational and data handling tasks. The instance scored 10,074.03 in PassMark CPU testing and achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 4,584.0. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression yielded 37.67 GB/sec, while Redis SET performance reached 8.27 million operations per second. However, single-core capabilities are constrained, evidenced by a lower single-core Geekbench score of 911.0 and a weak single-core stress-ng result of 1,102.49. The reliance on traditional local HDD storage rather than NVMe SSDs trades random IOPS performance for significantly higher storage density per instance.

The hardware architecture provides high resource density for workloads requiring vast local disk space without demanding high single-thread CPU performance. Combining 35 TB of local HDD capacity with 12 vCPUs offers favorable qualitative cost efficiency for data archiving, log analysis, Hadoop cluster nodes, and large-scale data processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.3xlarge is a storage-dense cloud server instance powered by 12 dedicated vCPUs derived from 6 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz. Equipped with 48 GB of RAM and an extensive local storage volume of 35,433 GB on hard disk drives, this instance prioritizes massive raw storage capacity alongside moderate compute and memory capabilities. Benchmark performance reflects an average overall multi-core capability with a PassMark CPU score of 10,074.03 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 4,584.0, despite weaker single-core processing metrics. Its 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth supports consistent data ingest. The hardware combination of extensive HDD space and balanced memory offers cost efficiency for storage-heavy deployment models, making it suitable for distributed file systems, data archiving, log processing, and big data analytical workloads.
